title: Prevent auxiliary memory refresh failures from surfacing as startup Agent errors
goal: Keep startup and routine session refresh from presenting a memory snapshot read failure as an Agent execution error, while preserving visible errors for explicit memory operations and genuine runtime/model failures.
context: RootView invokes KernelSession.refresh() on launch. refresh() called refreshMemory(), whose generic catch assigns lastError; AgentFeatureHub then presents that value as an Agent error card. A transient memory snapshot failure can therefore look like a core Agent failure even when execution is healthy.
forbidden_changes: Do not suppress genuine provider, model-load, or execution failures.
Do not alter explicit remember/forget/clear memory error reporting.
Do not change Agent Orb visuals or unrelated UI layout.
Do not claim physical iPhone verification from CI.
acceptance_criteria: Routine refresh loads memory snapshots without routing snapshot-only errors into global Agent lastError.
Cancellation during snapshot refresh exits without producing a user-facing failure.
Explicit memory actions retain existing refreshMemory error behavior.
Apple Native Build and Unsigned IPA passes on the final PR head.
verification: Review the exact KernelSession.refresh diff and confirm only the routine snapshot error path changed.
Run Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA on the PR head.
Physically relaunch on iPhone to confirm no false startup Attention Agent banner; separately verify genuine model/runtime failures remain visible.
recovery: If build or behavior regresses, revert this focused change; preserve the explicit memory-operation error path.
